data.name: Silent Crew
data.detailed_description:
You’ve decided to start your own urban exploration vlog "Silent Crew". Armed with your camera and curiosity, you set out to uncover forgotten buildings, hidden tunnels, and places that time left behind. What begins as a simple quest for views soon becomes a journey into the eerie and unexplained corners of the world.

Explore abandoned locations inspired by real-world urban decay. Search rooms, collect footage, and document your findings for your growing online audience. Each site tells its own story through environmental clues, scattered notes, and mysterious remnants of the past.

Can you uncover what happened within these walls and should some places really stay forgotten?

Features:

  • Explore detailed abandoned environments: schools, factories, hospitals, tunnels, and more

  • Use your digital camera to record, document, and uncover clues

  • Experience immersive atmospheric exploration with dynamic lighting and sound

  • Discover hidden items and environmental storytelling that reveal each location’s history

  • A slow-paced exploration adventure focused on mood, mystery, and discovery

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 550
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
